ekmrs57fbix4.speaker: iwamoto
ekmrs57fbix4.text: Where've you come from, then? …Far away, is it? I see.
ekmrs57fbix4.heard: where have you come from then? far away, is it? I see.

e1sygk6n1shdx.speaker: iwamoto
e1sygk6n1shdx.text: Osaka's a town of trade. And you can't trade on your own. It only works when everyone's there — people who sell, people who buy, people who carry, people who write it all down.
e1sygk6n1shdx.heard: Osaka's a town of trade. And you can't trade on your own. It only works when everyone's there — people who sell, people who buy, people who carry, people who write
e1sygk6n1shdx.scene: かなしみの場面。静かに、こらえるように。ときどき息がふるえる

e1j0aivak6l8t.speaker: iwamoto
e1j0aivak6l8t.text: So whatever you earn, you've got to give back to this town. …That's what my father always says.
e1j0aivak6l8t.heard: So whatever you earn, you've got to give back to this town. …That's what my father always
e1j0aivak6l8t.scene: かなしみの場面。静かに、こらえるように。ときどき息がふるえる

e1dmowa01l25j.speaker: nekmax
e1dmowa01l25j.text: That red-brick exchange is gone now. Today's Osaka Exchange building was rebuilt in 2004, keeping the front of the building put up in 1935.
e1dmowa01l25j.heard: That red-brick exchange is gone now. Today's Osaka Exchange building was rebuilt in 2004, keeping the front of the building put up in 1935.

e10pq6l41fjt8.speaker: nekmax
e10pq6l41fjt8.text: The statue in front of the building is Godai Tomoatsu. In 1878, he and his partners founded the Osaka Stock Exchange.
e10pq6l41fjt8.heard: The statue in front of the building is Godai Tomoatsu. In 1878, he and his partners founded the Osaka Stock Exchange.
e10pq6l41fjt8.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

exgcl9ny7vuc.speaker: nekmax
exgcl9ny7vuc.text: In 1909, Iwamoto travelled to America as a member of a group of Japanese businessmen. There he saw rich people giving their fortunes for everyone in their towns — and it moved him deeply.
exgcl9ny7vuc.heard: In 1909, Iwamoto travelled to America as a member of a group of Japanese businessmen. There he saw rich people giving their fortunes for everyone in their towns — and it moved him deeply.
exgcl9ny7vuc.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e19nz0um1j78d.speaker: nekmax
e19nz0um1j78d.text: Then in 1911, he gave one million yen — the money his father left him, plus his own — to the city of Osaka. People say that's billions of yen in today's money.
e19nz0um1j78d.heard: Then in 1911, he gave one million yen — the money his father left him, plus his own — to the city of Osaka. People say that's billions of yen in today's money.

elukts0wiyhs.speaker: nekmax
elukts0wiyhs.text: What that money built is the Osaka City Central Public Hall, across the river on Nakanoshima. Cross Naniwa Bridge and you're there in a few minutes.
